# AccuWeather
> AccuWeather provides local, national, and global weather forecasts, radar, maps, severe weather alerts, and weather intelligence services.

AccuWeather serves consumers with location-based forecasts and weather news, and also offers business weather data, APIs, and advertising solutions through dedicated product areas.

## Main Forecast Experience
- [Weather Forecast and Conditions](https://www.accuweather.com/): Main entry point for local weather forecasts, radar, alerts, and current conditions.
- [Hourly Weather Forecast](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/new-york/10007/hourly-weather-forecast/349727): Hour-by-hour forecast view with temperature, precipitation, wind, and cloud cover.
- [Daily Weather Forecast](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/new-york/10007/daily-weather-forecast/349727): Multi-day forecast with highs, lows, precipitation chances, and summary conditions.
- [Current Weather](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/new-york/10007/current-weather/349727): Current conditions page with temperature, RealFeel®, wind, and visibility details.
- [Weather Warnings](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/new-york/10007/weather-warnings/349727): Active local alerts and warning details for severe and hazardous weather.
- [Monthly Weather](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/new-york/10007/january-weather/349727): Historical and expected monthly weather patterns for trip and seasonal planning.

## Maps, Radar, and Severe Weather
- [Weather Radar](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/new-york/10007/weather-radar/349727): Interactive radar for precipitation tracking and storm movement.
- [Satellite and Radar Maps](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/national/weather-radar): National radar and satellite map views for broader weather systems.
- [MinuteCast®](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/new-york/10007/minute-weather-forecast/349727): Minute-by-minute precipitation forecast for the next several hours.
- [Hurricane Tracker](https://www.accuweather.com/en/hurricane): Hurricane news, maps, forecasts, and tropical storm tracking resources.
- [Severe Weather Map](https://www.accuweather.com/en/severe-weather-map): Map-based view of severe weather threats and impacted regions.
- [Lightning Map](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/national/lightning): National lightning activity map for storm monitoring.

## Health and Environmental Conditions
- [Air Quality Forecast](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/new-york/10007/air-quality-index/349727): Local air quality index, pollutant levels, and health guidance.
- [Allergy Forecast](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/new-york/10007/allergies-weather/349727): Pollen and allergy outlook with category-specific risk levels.
- [Flu Forecast](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/new-york/10007/flu-weather/349727): Weather-related flu activity outlook and local risk information.
- [Migraine Forecast](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/new-york/10007/migraine-weather/349727): Migraine risk forecast based on local weather conditions.
- [Arthritis Forecast](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/new-york/10007/arthritis-weather/349727): Joint pain risk guidance tied to changing local weather factors.
- [Sinus Pressure Forecast](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/new-york/10007/sinus-weather/349727): Sinus pressure outlook based on humidity, pressure, and weather changes.

## Lifestyle and Planning Forecasts
- [Running Weather](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/new-york/10007/running-weather/349727): Running conditions forecast with comfort and safety indicators.
- [Golf Weather](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/new-york/10007/golf-weather/349727): Golf activity forecast with course-day weather suitability guidance.
- [Fishing Weather](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/new-york/10007/fishing-weather/349727): Fishing conditions forecast using weather and environmental factors.
- [Outdoor Pests Forecast](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/new-york/10007/outdoor-pests-weather/349727): Mosquito and pest activity outlook for outdoor planning.
- [Astronomy and Sun & Moon](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/new-york/10007/daily-weather-forecast/349727?day=1): Forecast page including sunrise, sunset, and moon phase details.
- [Weekend Weather](https://www.accuweather.com/en/us/new-york/10007/weekend-weather/349727): Focused weekend forecast for short-term travel and event planning.

## Weather News and Editorial
- [Weather News](https://www.accuweather.com/en/weather-news): Editorial hub for breaking weather news, analysis, and feature stories.
- [Forecast News](https://www.accuweather.com/en/weather-news/weather-forecast-news): Coverage of forecast trends, storms, and upcoming weather patterns.
- [Severe Weather News](https://www.accuweather.com/en/severe-weather): News and updates on severe storms, flooding, tornadoes, and hazards.
- [Hurricane News](https://www.accuweather.com/en/hurricane): Tropical weather coverage, preparedness content, and storm updates.
- [Winter Weather News](https://www.accuweather.com/en/winter-weather): Snow, ice, and cold-weather forecast coverage and impacts.
- [Climate News](https://www.accuweather.com/en/climate): Climate-related reporting, trends, and long-range weather context.

## Video and Media
- [Weather Videos](https://www.accuweather.com/en/videos): Video hub for forecasts, storm coverage, and weather explainers.
- [AccuWeather NOW](https://www.accuweather.com/en/accuweather-now): Streaming weather video programming and live coverage.
- [Trending Weather Videos](https://www.accuweather.com/en/videos/trending-weather-news): Popular weather video clips and current event coverage.
- [Expert Forecast Videos](https://www.accuweather.com/en/videos/weather-forecast): Video forecasts and meteorologist-led outlooks.
- [Severe Weather Videos](https://www.accuweather.com/en/videos/severe-weather): Video coverage focused on storms, flooding, and dangerous weather.

## Business, APIs, and Data Services
- [AccuWeather for Business](https://business.accuweather.com/): Business weather products, enterprise solutions, and industry-focused forecasting services.
- [Weather APIs](https://developer.accuweather.com/): Developer portal for forecast, current conditions, alerts, and location APIs.
- [API Documentation](https://developer.accuweather.com/apis): Overview of available AccuWeather API products and capabilities.
- [Locations API](https://developer.accuweather.com/accuweather-locations-api/apis): API for location search, geoposition lookup, and regional metadata.
- [Forecast API](https://developer.accuweather.com/accuweather-forecast-api/apis): API for daily and hourly forecast data access.
- [Current Conditions API](https://developer.accuweather.com/current-conditions-api/apis): API for real-time observed weather conditions.
- [Alerts API](https://developer.accuweather.com/accuweather-alerts-api/apis): API for weather alerts and government-issued warning data.
- [Indices API](https://developer.accuweather.com/indices-api/apis): API for lifestyle, health, and activity-based weather indices.

## Advertising and Brand Solutions
- [AccuWeather Advertising](https://advertising.accuweather.com/): Advertising platform for weather-triggered campaigns and audience targeting.
- [Solutions by Vertical](https://advertising.accuweather.com/solutions-by-vertical/): Industry-specific advertising offerings for sectors like retail and automotive.
- [Capabilities](https://advertising.accuweather.com/capabilities/): Overview of targeting, creative, and campaign execution capabilities.
- [Research and Insights](https://advertising.accuweather.com/research-and-insights/): Marketing research and weather-driven audience insight resources.
- [Contact Advertising](https://advertising.accuweather.com/contact-us/): Contact page for advertising inquiries and partnership discussions.
